reported_fitted_or_used.name: Spindle encoder
reported_fitted_or_used.source_line: The owner reports a mixed axis drive arrangement: a servo on Z and step motors on X and Y. They added an encoder to the spindle motor for an index signal and state that the VFD has a built-in index function. The forum post links owner demonstration videos for a G-code test run and an ATC test run; the post's wording and linked demonstrations are evidence of reported test activity, not a complete commissioning record.
